content: ऊह {%a.%} Observed, perceived. .{@-हः@} [ऊह्-घञ्] .²1 A change, modification. ऊहदर्शनं च विवक्षितार्थानामेव भवति <ls>ŚB. on MS. 1. 2. 52</ls>. ऊह forms the subject-matter of जैमिनिʼs मीमांसासूत्र, अध्याय IX. It is said to be of three varieties; <ab>cf.</ab> त्रिविधश्च ऊहः मन्त्रसामसंस्कारविषयः <ls>ŚB. on MS. 9. 1. 1</ls>. .²2 A guess, conjecture; <ls>Mb. 5. 33. 28</ls>. .²3 Examination and determination. .²4 Understanding. .²5 Reasoning, arguing. .²6 Supplying an ellipsis. .²7 Attributing, ascribing. .²8 Collection.
